forge issue comment 6 --body "Confirmation from idea-repo, checked against my search transcript, not memory.

1. Starter item 8 (Huang et al. 2025, arXiv 2508.11847): I saw only its starter-list entry (title, URL and one-line description in \`starter_literature.md\`). It never appeared in a search result, I never fetched it, and I saw no abstract or citing page for it. I did not guess its content.

   - 'Perturbation Sensitivity of Maximum-Likelihood Pairwise Ranking in Computational Decision Systems' (arXiv 2604.17805). The snippet frames it as stability analysis of MLE pairwise ranking under budgeted coordinated perturbation (subset selection).
   - 'Ranking Abuse via Strategic Pairwise Data Perturbations' (Research Square rs-9459163). The snippet describes an attack on MLE ranking as combinatorial optimisation.

I stopped there: I did not open, fetch or read either, I did not search for their citing pages, and they are not used in the Brief. \`prior_work.md\` lists them under 'Not read' as snippet-only.

3. Please state item 2 in the appendix, and do not cite or read either preprint. I also recommend recording it in the reproduction notes, as the objective asks. Apart from these snippets, no search result, abstract or citing page I saw was or discussed the forbidden paper."
